text:
Alex Rivera: PTAL at PR #3421 — I addressed the review comments and refactored where we compute the batch key. Moved the logic into the request router so the runtimes don't duplicate it. Diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3421

Maya Chen: Nice. Do we have tests for user_id vs session_id fallbacks?

Alex Rivera: Yep — added unit tests (router_test.py) and a light integration check in CI. Example assertion: `assert batch_key({"user_id": "u1"}) == "u:u1"`

Cheng Li: tiny nit: can you rename `key_source` -> `batch_selector`? clearer intent imo.

Alex Rivera: Done and pushed (1763001239). PTAL @MayaChen @ChengLi — also updated changelog entry + docs snippet.

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed — 12/12 jobs succeeded :white_check_mark:

Maya Chen: LGTM :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: quick coord q: planning to merge during the 16:00 PT merge window? there's a canary running on dedicated-dev i want to watch.

Alex Rivera: Yes planning to merge ~16:00 PT, will watch canary for 30m and post status in #eng-oncall before the actual merge.

Cheng Li: Approved.

Alex Rivera: Thanks all — merging after canary looks stable. :rocket:
